Based on the provided passages, the colors of the Tennessee flag have the following meanings:

* White represents purity and innocence
* Blue represents the patriotism of the people of Tennessee
* Red represents the willingness of the people of Tennessee to shed blood during warfare

Additionally, the three white stars on the flag represent the three grand divisions of Tennessee - East, Middle, and West - which are bound together by the endless circle of the blue field.
